about_item: Adjustable table height: The height-adjustable drawing table measures 120.5x60x(69.5-92.5)cm/ 47.5x23.6x(27.5-36.5)” (LxWxH) in overall dimensions. Rest assured that all the fittings applied (e.g. metal connectors, plastic knobs and more) work well to ease your every single adjustment.

Easy angle adjustment: The angle of the tabletop can be adjusted from 0 to 60° by simply lifting/lowering the top. This practical table works perfectly as a regular flat table for your laptop/books, and an easel for drawing and drafting.

Durable pencil ledge: The drawing board has an adjustable metal pencil ledge attached to the front edge to keep your drawing instruments from sliding/rolling off at a tilted angle. A special adjustment fitting design for you to lock and loose the pencil ledge with ease.

Retractable auxiliary surface: A 38 x 60cm/ 15 x 23.6’’ flat surface on the left can be pulled out for placing laptop and tablet to display pictures as drawing references, or an extra storage space for palette, documents, etc.; the side table can be slid under the main tabletop if needed.

Table/stool set: This drafting table set includes a stool in the package, which features a sturdy construction of a well finished metal frame and color/style matching black PU-wrapped sponge padding round seat. Now enjoy the added comfort!

summary.text: Customers find the drafting table to be a great desk that offers good value for money and is perfect for drawing and other art or craft projects. They appreciate its storage compartments, spacious design, and small footprint, with one customer noting it fits a 2x2x2' plenum. However, the stability is concerning as the structure wobbles with the slightest touch, and customers report durability issues with the fake wood breaking easily. The height adjustment mechanism receives mixed feedback, with some finding it easily adjustable while others find it incredibly difficult to adjust.
